answer: Here is a specific defense: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. An identity earns only when its atlas recurs, its grove survives audit, and a zephyr from an unlinked peer confirms it.
